dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 09, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"Braves Blast Pirates in 10-5 Thriller, Yankees Rout Rays 12-4"

The Atlanta Braves continued their winning ways with a 10-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, led by Matt Olson's strong performance. In a game filled with power hitting, Drake Baldwin and Mike Yastrzemski also made significant contributions. Yastrzemski's grand slam in the 6th inning proved to be the turning point, scoring three runs and giving the Braves a 9-5 lead. On the mound, Dylan Dodd earned the win for the Braves, while Mitch Keller took the loss for the Pirates.

Meanwhile, the New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 12-4, with Ben Rice leading the charge. Rice hit two home runs and drove in five runs, helping the Yankees secure their second win of the night. Cody Bellinger also had a strong game, singling in a run in the 8th inning. Ryan Yarbrough earned the win for the Yankees, while Drew Rasmussen took the loss for the Rays.

In other games, the Cleveland Guardians edged out the Minnesota Twins 5-2 behind a strong performance from Gavin Williams, who struck out 11 batters in seven innings. The Boston Red Sox also won, taking down the Chicago White Sox 2-1 in a pitchers' duel.
